title: Kinhold Update: Creating a voxel survival/colony sim
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Using Claude for code. I have switch out the Synty assets (except the player character, that is in the works) for custom made models using Blender. Added some textures to the voxels (still tweaking this a bit). Whats not shown, as they are under development: Adding multiple materials to the modular building components, workbenches and stations, improved inventory system.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body:
Not a full gameplay loop, we have much still to do. Where we are at: A randomized voxel world (shareable seeds, even) for new games, about 30% of resources (basically, all the building based resources) are in the game and modeled, and already started on the recipes and workbenches. Inventory system is getting polished. Modular building is mostly done, just tweaking the odder shapes and the snapping system.  
  
Where we go next: making sure the biomes have all of their resources, and completing the recipes and making sure everything is tied to a workstation, and has a model for inventory or to see carried or equipped. Once we do that, we are going to build out the colony/settlement sim portion. Once you have settlers gathering and crafting, we are going to build out the enemy system. It will add in combat, enemy settlements (some with boss style battles), the enemy raid system, and the settler-to-army switch to allow for full scale battles. End game is expanding your settlement, equipping your army, surviving the higher level raids, and defeating enemy settlements.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Right now, yeah, the goal for end game is defeating enemy large settlements. It can change based on playtesting, or if something else comes up.

comments.author: KashXz
comments.body: What engine is this? Or is it strictly web browser?

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: This is in Unity, end goal is PC game.

comments.author: Mission_Bullfrog3294
comments.body: Can you dig tunnels?  looks really cool.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Yep, you can dig in any direction, as long as there is something to dig through. You can create underground tunnels, caverns, and you could put some of your base down there to make it harder to reach when we implement enemy raids.

comments.author: Mission_Bullfrog3294
comments.body: That’s gonna be super cool.  Why are you building models in blender?   Meshy and Tripo are great and cheap, Custom rigging and animations in blender seem necessary still in my experiences

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: I wanted a bit of a blocky style, and to keep it simple.

comments.author: ehhhhokbud
comments.body: What sets this apart from being a worse Minecraft?

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Wont know until we get all the systems in and playtested. But so far the graphics and planned systems aren't in regular Minecraft, so we have that going for us.
